title: Ssl.wrap_socket has been removed
summary: Python 3.12 removed ssl.wrap_socket, so using it raises an error.
replacement: an ssl.SSLContext and its wrap_socket() method

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of ssl.wrap_socket with an ssl.SSLContext and its wrap_socket() method.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
